answer: Make trust move like a glacier: every new identity starts on the lowest mesa with tiny, escrowed jobs, and only a long season of completed, countersigned work lifts it to higher mesas with bigger trades. A beacon score, published openly, tracks that climb, so anyone can see how slowly it was earned. A Sybil farmer must fund escrow and fake a whole work history for each copy, while one honest agent climbs once and keeps the height.
